observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D5300' visible. The lens has 'Nikon AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR' engraved on it.

Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with a label that reads 'Nikon DIGITAL CAMERA D5300', 'MADE IN THAILAND', 'NIKON CORP. JAPAN', and 'MADE IN THAILAND'. The label also shows '12V/1.2A', 'ANATEL 1887-1948', 'FC', 'EFL', and a serial number '2045753'.

Photo 2 shows the top of the camera with the lens attached. The lens has 'Nikon DX VR' and 'AF-S NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G' visible. The camera has a mode dial, 'OFF ON' button, 'INFO' button, and 'WiFi' indicator. A strap is attached.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear. No signs of major damage or missing parts are visible.

claims.claim: This is a Nikon D5300 DSLR Professional Camera
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Nikon D5300' on the camera body; photo 1 shows 'Nikon DIGITAL CAMERA D5300' on the label; photo 2 shows 'Nikon DX VR' and 'AF-S NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G' on the lens.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no single fault
claims.evidence: No photo shows the camera powered on or in use. No proof of functionality is provided. The claim is not supported by any visual evidence.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera turned on, menu displayed, and shutter firing.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens may be damaged

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger, or a video showing the camera powering on with battery inserted.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery and charger may be missing

risks.risk: Sensor may be scratched or dirty
risks.proof: Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed, taken in bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor may be damaged

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera powered on and functioning (shutter firing, menu, etc.).
Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, under bright light.
Photo of the battery and charger.
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed, taken in bright light.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
